programme.title: LILIA SCHWARCZ - KRITIKÊ PODCAST
programme.desc: Lilia Katri Moritz Schwarcz é uma historiadora e antropóloga brasileira nascida em São Paulo, em 1957. Ela é doutora em antropologia social pela Universidade de São Paulo (USP) e atualmente ocupa o cargo de professora titular na Faculdade de Filosofia, Letras e Ciências Humanas (FFLCH/USP). Além disso, Lilia Schwarcz é uma das acadêmicas mais influentes na área de ciências humanas, com um legado significativo para a cultura e literatura brasileira. Ela é fundadora da editora Companhia das Letras, juntamente com seu marido, Luiz Schwarcz. Entre suas obras notáveis estão “As Barbas do Imperador”, que aborda a vida de Dom Pedro II e venceu o Prêmio Jabuti de 1999 na categoria não-ficção, e “Brasil: Uma Biografia”, escrito em parceria com Heloisa M. Starling. Além disso, Lilia Schwarcz também publicou um livro sobre o autoritarismo no Brasil, intitulado "Sobre o Autoritarismo Brasileiro: uma breve história de cinco séculos". Em 2024, Lilia Schwarcz foi eleita para compor a cadeira númer...

programme.title: Baby Einstein Ocean Explorers
programme.desc: Cal, Neptune, Opus, Dean, Tinker and others learn about the flora and fauna of the ocean through STEAM-based principles and real-life footage.

programme.title: The Sandbox
programme.desc: The Sandbox is where our favorite Baby Einstein characters gather to play, problem-solve and have fun. Each five-minute episode explores an area of curiosity relevant to our 2-4 year old audience. Since the four weathered planks of wood that make up the structure of their sandbox are no obstacles for their imaginations, the entire universe is available to them for each new adventure.

programme.title: Manners Manor
programme.desc: Introducing "Manners Manor," a new series from Baby Einstein. Designed to help your child learn all about manners in a fun and thoughtful way. The content is based on "The Einstein Way" - a curiosity-driven learning philosophy, from industry experts, inspired by Montessori and STEAM. It also reflects our core belief that curiosity is the most important skill for our kids to learn in order to be successful and adaptable in an ever-changing world.

programme.title: Baby Einstein Classics
programme.desc: Between 12 and 24 months, little ones become increasingly interested in more complex ideas and begin to explore numbers and counting. Numbers Nursery introduces little ones to numerals 1 through 5 in a captivating, interactive way that invites them to join in, clap their hands and count out loud.

programme.title: Baby Einstein Classics
programme.desc: As little ones become better acquainted with the world, they grow curious about animals of all kinds, beyond just the family pet. And as their communication skills continue to develop, they enjoy imitating animal sounds as well. Baby Noah Animal Expedition takes your little explorer across the globe to meet animals -- two-by-two -- from the savannah, the rainforest and tropics, the Outback, the ocean and the Polar Regions.

programme.title: Baby Einstein Classics
programme.desc: Sharing the joys and traditions of the holiday season with your little one is truly one of the greatest gifts of parenthood, and Baby Santa's Music Box makes this magical time even more special! Celebrate by treating your baby and yourself to a captivating wonderland of bright lights, sparkling ornaments, sleigh bells, toys, winter scenes, jolly Santas and more -- all accompanied by beloved holiday melodies.

programme.title: Baby Einstein New Classics
programme.desc: Journey to the classroom with your favorite Baby Einstein friends! Learn about what makes your face incredible, baby's first sounds, and counting in different languages with a focus on Spanish! Real-life engaging imagery, upbeat classical melodies and gentle narration and repetition introduce first words, faces and a variety of different languages to young viewers.

programme.title: Baby Einstein Classics
programme.desc: As babies develop, their understanding of the world, and how its pieces "fit" together, continues to progress. DISCOVERING SHAPES playfully introduces five basic forms circle, oval, triangle, square and rectangle as each appears in the context of toys, nature and everyday objects.

programme.title: Baby Einstein Classics
programme.desc: One of the greatest joys you'll ever experience is bonding with your baby during those calm, quiet moments. Lullaby Time: Soothing Sounds for Baby provides comforting sights and sounds as you relax and share this precious downtime.

programme.title: Baby Einstein New Classics
programme.desc: Discover the wonderful world of water and deep dive into all the amazing creatures that call the ocean home. Learn simple words about the sea like water, coral reef, and ocean through narration and repetition. Engaging live-action footage of your favorite ocean friends and classical melodies will dazzle your little explorer as they experience the magical world under the sea.

Jay (Jackie Chan’s son), the hotshot security guard in charge of the security of this painting is busy preparing for the event. A bumbling tourist from Beijing - Ocean turns his life upside down. Ocean, a security guard in his neighborhood, wins a prize for a vacation in Taiwan. While visiting the museum, he becomes the only witness to the theft of the painting by international crime boss Z. Jay forces Ocean to join him on the quest to retrieve the painting. While on the road, the two guys are constantly at each other’s throats but eventually learn to put aside their differences and work together as a team.

programme.title: I'M LIVE - Kim Jae-hyung episode 222
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter Kim Jae-hyung! Kim Jae-hyung is a self-taught guitarist who picked up the guitar when he was serving in the NAVY as a secretary for the naval military band. He continued playing the instrument after his discharge and had the first public performance in 2013 at an unplugged open mic night. Then in 2017 he released his first EP CIRCUS. Three years later he presented his first full-length album Flex which was nominated for Best Folk Album at the 2021 Korean Music Awards and the lead single Failure Story was nominated for Best Folk Song. Kim Jae-hyung is also known for covering a wide spectrum of music. Recently he came up with a new single titled Addiction with danceable vibes. Constantly pushing his musical boundaries this artist definitely makes us look forward to his future moves. In this episode Kim Jae-hyung performs Addiction Failure Story More Doubt and more. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this talented artist!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - J_ust episode 223
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is a singer who just wants to present good music - J_ust! J_ust made his debut in 2015 with the mini-album #DearMuse #201507_08 #PinkRibbon. Known for his heartfelt lyrics and sounds he comforts numerous listeners at the end of a tough day. Thanks to that magical power Jeong Eun-ji from Apink released a remake of his song How's your night for the soundtrack of She's My Type and his song Way Back Home was featured in the ending of JTBC Newsroom. In this episode J_ust performs How's your night Way Back Home I wanna go out Actually I like you and will be happy to console everyone's heart. Tune in to I'm LIVE and enjoy all the heartwarming songs he has to comfort you!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - YESEO episode 224
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is electronic musician and producer YESEO! This artist burst into the music scene in 2016 with her first single Let It All Go. Two years later in 2018 she was nominated for Best Rookie Best Dance & Electronic Album Best Dance & Electronic Song at the 15th Korean Music Awards with her first EP Million Things. This talented musician mesmerized not only domestic listeners but those outside Korea. The UK's Noisey highlighted YESEO as one of the most ambitious young guns in Seoul and she even opened for Cherokee and Honne during their concerts in Seoul. In this episode YESEO performs Privacy HOT HAND Cigarette Light as well as Youthful Kids and Free Up from her latest EP TRY TREE! Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this talented artist!

programme.title: The Griddle of Joseon: Metal Casting Master
programme.desc: From molten metal to cast iron cookware, traditional casting techniques shaped the daily tools of the Joseon era. The griddle, born from fire and precision, reflects the balance of practicality and artistry. (Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Art of Steel: Ornamental Knife Making Master
programme.desc: Small in size, yet rich in meaning—ornamental knives once symbolized both elegance and status. Through intricate forging and decorative detail, these steel blades carry the strength and refinement of tradition. (Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Flowering Devotion: Shoe Making Master
programme.desc: Traditional Korean shoes, delicately stitched petal by petal, are more than footwear—they embody beauty, craftsmanship, and heartfelt wishes. Each step in their making reflects generations of devotion passed down through time. (Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Soaring Squid: Jeolla Province Ritual Food Master
programme.desc: In southern Korea, a dried squid transforms into a phoenix on the ritual table. This delicate food art, rooted in care and reverence, embodies the spirit and blessing of traditional ceremonies. (Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Enduring the Summer Heat: Mat Weaving
programme.desc: In the sweltering summer, hands weave coolness from strands of sedge. Each mat, boiled, dried, and tightly woven, holds the wisdom of tradition and the breath of community. (Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Abundant Tea Table: Royal Confectionery Autumn Table
programme.desc: Enjoy the taste of the bountiful autumn with the perfect royal confectionery autumn table, filled with abundant fruit flower rice cakes. (Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Dyeing in Royal Red: Red Dyeing Master
programme.desc: The Great Red Color, once a royal hue, is drawn from blossoms through repeated extraction and careful dyeing. Each layer of color deepens through the artisan’s steady hands, preserving a legacy of elegance and tradition. (Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Full of Sensations: Royal Confectionery Tea Table
programme.desc: Let’s make a tea table full of sensations! Experience various delicacies filled with dedication and handmade taste, such as mugwort rice cake balls (Ssukguridan) and twisted flour dough flower rice cakes. (Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Quilting with Devotion: Quilting Master
programme.desc: Hand-stitched layer by layer, traditional nubi quilting is a labor of patience, care, and artistry. The countless straight, repeated stitches not only provide warmth and durability but also reveal a quiet beauty passed down through generations. (Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Unwavering Focus: The Horsehair Headband Making Master
programme.desc: Made by meticulously weaving fine strands of horsehair, the manggeon was a refined headpiece worn by men in the Joseon era. Each knot reflects the artisan’s steady hand and quiet discipline. Experience the silent intensity behind this delicate craft. (Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Welcome Spring: Royal Confectionery Spring Table
programme.desc: Capturing the perfect snack that matches spring best, the sounds of making royal confectionery. Experience the taste and style filled with the scent of spring. (Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Artisans Who Carve Masterpieces: Sobanjang
programme.desc: Soban (small tray table) is a small table for placing dishes of food, playing an important role in Korean dining culture. Appreciate the traditional soban filled with the artisan spirit of the Sobanjang. (Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Beauty of Patience: Ottchil Master
programme.desc: A Ottchil Master is an artisan skilled in decorating objects and furniture surfaces beautifully with ottchil (natural varnish/lacquer) and shells. Appreciate the works filled with the dedication and patience of the Lacquerware Master. (Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Carving for the Sacred: Metal Engraving Master
programme.desc: Metal carving, a tradition rooted in the Bronze Age, lives on in the intricate patterns engraved onto sarira reliquaries. Each hammer strike reflects the artisan’s devotion, preserving the sacred through centuries of skill. (Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Legacy of Sound: Daegeum Master
programme.desc: Daegeum, which is one of Korea's representative traditional instruments is a wind instrument with holes drilled into bamboo to produce sound. Let’s follow the work process of these artisans who keep the tradition alive. (Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Seal - Live at Soundstage
programme.desc: A aveludada e potente voz barítono de Seal é perfeita para qualquer gênero. Ele encanta os fãs e é aclamado pela crítica sem se afastar das composições clássicas e sinceras em uma notável carreira de duas décadas. Agora, ele repete a dose com o lançamento do excepcional sexto álbum de estúdio, Soul. Acompanhado do lendário produtor musical David Foster, Seal dá um toque especial às melhores músicas soul já criadas. Em uma impressionante apresentação, Seal evoca uma época em que a música vividamente incorporava a emoção e o romance. Com Foster, um coral e uma seção cordas, Seal comanda I Cant Stand the Rain, de Ann Pebbles; A Change Is Gonna Come, de Sam Cooke; e If You Dont Know Me By Now, de Harold Melvin and the Blue Notes. Aperte o play para mais sucessos que nunca saem da moda, como Kiss From a Rose.

programme.title: O Poder e a Lei

programme.title: A Última Fortaleza

programme.title: Sexta-Feira 13 – Parte IV: O Capítulo Final

programme.title: Amor Além do Tempo

programme.title: Un Desejo De Natal

programme.title: O Natal Pormetido 2

Ele só está interessado em fazer boa figura ao parecer caridoso. Ivy fica feliz quando ele vai embora, mas um acidente fere um dos conselheiros de confiança de Dylan, Blake. Dylan insiste que Ivy fique na luxuosa propriedade de Dylan em Bali para cuidar de Blake até que ele se recupere.

programme.title: Casamento Relâmpago

As motivações de Kelly são reveladas e as tragédias em torno de sua gangue são mostradas de forma intensa e poderosa, a começar pelo amor de uma mãe por seu filho.

Inicialmente, o cético Elliot precisa matar uma mosca e depois comê-la. Após cada tarefa, Elliot encontra o depósito prometido em sua conta bancária. Ele decide aceitar o convite, e as tarefas se tornam agressivas, macabras, brutais e ofensivas. Quando Elliot decide desistir do jogo, percebe que não há volta para ele.
